messages.en:
{07 15 00}Hey, {04 1f 00}!{01 00 00 0f 00}
{07 0b 00}Did you already forget,
{01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}?
{07 06 00}What I want is a shirt!
{01 00 00 05 00}A SHIRT!{01 00 00 0a 00} Don't forget again!

{07 16 00}It doesn't matter which
one. I just want to have a
shirt, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}...
{07 06 00}Even a used one is fine!{01 00 00 0f 00}
Seriously, I'm not a shirt
snob, {01 00 00 05 00}{04 02 00}!
